control_basis: True merge base, not the GitHub API baseRefOid
change: Fuse GLU into MMQ Q8_1 activation quantization

correctness.scope: Upstream evaluation cases, including layouts and fallback paths; exact full-model expert geometry is in the upstream performance cases, not its correctness set

benchmark.telemetry: One-second GPU power, SM clock, temperature, utilization and clock-event reasons
benchmark.decision_rule: Require both orderings to clear the gates without a telemetry confound before advancing; otherwise park as insufficient or inconclusive evidence
benchmark.calibration_adjustment: Always finish one bounded opposite-order pair. Prior unchanged-binary A/A prefill varied by -9.67% and -4.25%, so a single short prefill result is not standalone rejection evidence
benchmark.retry_policy: No repeated reruns of a marginal result

deployment: Unchanged; a speed screen does not authorize deployment
